messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The configuration of 13 points in the unit square maximizing the minimum triangle area consists of the four corners, two points at (1/3,0) and (2/3,0) on the bottom edge, two points at (0,1/2) and (1,1/2) on the left and right edges, one point at (1/2,1/2) at the center, two points at (1/3,1) and (2/3,1) on the top edge, and two points at (1/2,1/3) and (1/2,2/3) on the vertical midline, achieving a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/18. This is optimal because any 13-point configuration in the unit square forces two triangles among the 286 triples to have area at most 1/18, which can be proven by partitioning the square into 12 triangles of equal area 1/12 and applying the pigeonhole principle to the 220 point-triangle incidences to guarantee a triangle containing two points forming a sub-triangle of area at most 1/18."}
